item.title: ECR 2026: Foetoscopic Spina Bifida Repair Reduces Foetal Brain Oedema
item.description: Fetoscopic repair of spina bifida reduces brain edema and hindbrain bulging, but postoperative aqueductal obstruction remains a risk, study shows. The post ECR 2026: Foetoscopic Spina Bifida Repair Reduces Foetal Brain Oedema appeared first on European Medical Journal.

item.title: NHS England London Launches Drive to Improve Heart Health
item.description: NHS England London has launched a five-year, city-wide programme to improve heart health in the capital. The post NHS England London Launches Drive to Improve Heart Health appeared first on European Medical Journal.

item.title: FDA Warns 30 Telehealth Companies Against Illegal GLP-1 Marketing
item.description: The FDA has issued warning letters to 30 telehealth companies for reportedly making false claims about GLP-1 products, amid a major crackdown on pharmaceutical advertisements. The post FDA Warns 30 Telehealth Companies Against Illegal GLP-1 Marketing appeared first on European Medical Journal.

item.title: Gut Microbiota May Shape SCLC Metastasis
item.description: A new review has highlighted the gut microbiota as a potential systemic driver of liver metastasis in small cell lung cancer, shifting attention beyond tumor genetics alone to the gut liver axis. The post Gut Microbiota May Shape SCLC Metastasis appeared first on European Medical Journal.

item.title: Rising CT Scans in Elderly Raise Radiation Questions
item.description: The proportion of CT scans performed in patients aged 60–90 has risen over 10 years at a hospital, highlighting concerns about repeated radiation exposure. The post Rising CT Scans in Elderly Raise Radiation Questions appeared first on European Medical Journal.

item.title: MASLD: The Leading Cause of Cirrhosis in South America?
item.description: Multicentre study in South America suggests MASLD is a leading cause of cirrhosis, highlighting rising metabolic risk factors and gender-balanced insights. The post MASLD: The Leading Cause of Cirrhosis in South America? appeared first on European Medical Journal.

item.title: Could Adaptive AI Reshape Neuroplasticity and Cognitive Autonomy?
item.description: Adaptive artificial intelligence may reshape neuroplasticity, raising concern that cognitive autonomy could be gradually compromised. The post Could Adaptive AI Reshape Neuroplasticity and Cognitive Autonomy? appeared first on European Medical Journal.

item.title: WHO Updates Influenza Vaccine Strains for 2026–27 Season
item.description: The WHO has announced updated influenza vaccine strains for the 2026–27 northern hemisphere season, reflecting evolving flu virus patterns worldwide. The post WHO Updates Influenza Vaccine Strains for 2026–27 Season appeared first on European Medical Journal.

item.title: Pipe and Cigar Smoking Linked to Faster Lung Decline
item.description: Pipe and cigar smoking is linked to faster lung function decline and higher mortality, even among people who have never smoked cigarettes. The post Pipe and Cigar Smoking Linked to Faster Lung Decline appeared first on European Medical Journal.

item.title: PPIs Show Antifibrotic Effects in Eosinophilic Oesophagitis
